items.html: MA means the new coupling that came out for the sake of Atzilut, after all the lights of ZAT of Nekudim and the Gadlut of GAR of Nekudim had departed. For then the whole screen of the Guf of Nekudim was refined, and rose together with all the records of Katnut and Gadlut included in it, to the Rosh of SAG, and was included in the coupling that took place there, and the records within it were renewed, and there first came out the ten Sefirot of Katnut and Gadlut of Atik, and afterward all twelve Partzufim of Atzilut came out one from another. Now, all these new levels are all called by the name the new MA. And it is known that every lower Partzuf fills the vessels that were emptied of their lights when the upper Partzuf was refined; and behold, just so, the whole Partzuf of the new MA likewise fills the vessels of the Partzuf of Nekudim with its lights, and these vessels as a whole are called by the name BON. However, there was here a new matter, for the vessels that are filled with the lights of the lower one, in the case of the Partzufim of AK, are not considered the aspect of a Nukva to the lower Partzuf; rather, on the contrary, they remain more important than the vessels of the lower one. But here the vessels of the upper Partzuf became the aspect of a Nukva to the lower Partzuf, since BON, which is from the previous vessels of Nekudim, became a Nukva to MA, which is lower than Nekudim. And the reason for this is that there is here a great change, since the vessels of Nekudim broke and fell into BYA, which had not happened with the earlier Partzufim of AK. Hence the vessels of BON became the aspect of a Nukva to MA, even though it is lower than they are. And as for the matter of the vessels of the new MA: behold, they resemble the earlier Partzufim of AK, as was explained in the previous parts — that in every Partzuf there are two kinds of vessels. The first are the vessels of the upper Partzuf, whose lights departed on account of refinement. The second are the vessels that come out with the new level of the lower one, since after the ten Sefirot of the Rosh come out, from the Malchut of the Rosh upward, afterward the Malchut expands from herself and within herself into ten Sefirot from above downward, in lights and vessels, in the same measure that the direct light clothed from below upward in the Rosh; and these vessels of the expansion of Malchut from above downward are called the new vessels of the Partzuf, see there. And so it is also with MA: those vessels that came out with the new MA, namely on account of the expansion of Malchut from above downward, which occurs in every Partzuf, are the new vessels of MA, whereas the vessels of the upper Partzuf, namely of Nekudim, are those of BON. See above, Part Four, page 269, Inner Observation, item 68 and item 71. (Inner Light, page 613, Sub Header, “Coupling”)
